query: SELECT p.id, p.name, pv.id as variantId, pv.size, pv.color, pv.retailPrice FROM products p LEFT JOIN productVariants pv ON p.id = pv.productId WHERE p.name LIKE '%Flag Bearer%' ORDER BY pv.id;
